d: I et superuhyggeligt Halloween-afsnit taler Daniel med nogle døve drag queens, viser os nogle smagløse kostumer og beviser en gang for alle, at alle spøgelser er 100% ægte.
Daniel hjælper en adrenalinjunkie få en overdosis, introducerer de mest beskidte stoddere på internettet og tilbyder valgresultater, som man kan regne med.
Daniel afgør internettets mest ophedede huldebat, introducerer nye sportsgrene og præsenterer tilbagevenden af det mest utilfredsstillende segment i tv.
Daniel deler nogle minder fra 2018, som han helst vil fortrænge, og taler med sin favorit-fodboldanalytiker med den beskidte kæft.
Daniel sits down with the most confident man on social media, reads life-ruining tweets and puts his own spin on the Cheese Challenge.
Daniel meets a woman who makes a living polishing turds, breaks down a video of a man and his sinking pickup truck and checks out some soap-cutting videos.
Daniel talks to a man who enjoys acting like a horse, makes the case for celebrating all birthdays on the same day and exposes celebrities without their makeup.
Daniel meets a low-energy energy drink reviewer, explores the fine art of balloon popping and breaks down video of a man getting a "purple shower."
Daniel learns vape tricks from some Canadian bros, finds out about a jousting expert's made-up language and assesses the injuries of two stabbing victims.
Daniel sits down with a man who makes a living sneezing online for fetishists, reveals his method of self-defense and compares British and American road rage.
Daniel breaks down a video of an over-the-top ATM heist, meets an arm wrestling champ with giant limbs and video chats with two men who demand value from their potato chips.

t: Tosh.0 ToshCon: Where Are They Now?
d: Daniel reunites with past guests at the inaugural ToshCon, interviews BYU's first openly gay valedictorian for a job and gives a special thank you to his fans.
Daniel examines a swinging tattoo convention, tests social media star SteveWillDoIt's limits, talks sports in Around the Horn.0 and unveils the Aussie Viddie of the Weekie.
Daniel meets with "intactivist" Brother K, teams up with Dom Irrera to quiz a focus group about racist terms and examines a video of a dog dancing to an accordion.

t: Tosh.0 October 1, 2019 - "I Eat Ass" Free Speech Defender
d: Daniel gets his staff fired up for tape day, interviews an ass-eating First Amendment protector and is unnerved by videos of a man who pies himself in the face.
Daniel reviews a college student's shocking night, meets a 12-year-old with a love for songs about video games, and reveals what it's really like to attend a live taping.
Daniel welcomes his best-smelling guest ever and wealth-shames young people on TikTok.
Daniel takes inspiration from a woman who sprayed milk from her breasts at a music festival, is taught how to slackline at the office and meets with a renowned burp fetishist.
Daniel looks at a gross way to maximize soup intake, meets a viral superhero with an anti-bullying message and watches parents traumatize their kids for Halloween.

t: Tosh.0 November 5, 2019 - Pot Brothers at Law
d: Daniel breaks down a video of a father-son napping duo, meets two brothers who practice law and have a penchant for pot, and helps Todd Glass tame his prank show.
Daniel suffers an unfortunate pool-ball injury, sits down with a divorcee-turned-Instagram influencer and starts a podcast dedicated to trashing an old foe.
Daniel continues to carry the weight of the entire network, looks back at the most memorable moments of 2019 and helps the Hallmark Channel diversify.
Daniel premieres the episode filmed before the COVID-19 pandemic shut down production on the show and pays tribute to a late friend and Hollywood star.
Daniel bravely reopens amidst America's COVID-19 shutdowns, determines what's cake and what isn't, and sits down with YouTube sensation Rebecca Black.
Daniel digs into horticulture with help from a glamorous gardener, then learns the art of cooking without looking.
Daniel gets frisky with America's number one cat food connoisseur and helps his staff orgasm using only the power of his mind.
Daniel does his best to make a bodybuilder cry and shows off a new invention that takes potties to a whole new level of porta.
Daniel heads to the desert with a porn star and gets to know an artist living with attention-deficit disorder.
Daniel meets an easily impressed urban explorer and plays another installment of America's goriest game show, just in time for Halloween!
Daniel analyzes the 2020 presidential election with the best political minds who have appeared on Tosh.0, and he dials up his favorite computer programmer who dresses like a cat.
Daniel talks with a white kid about the rap game and reveals the embarrassing side hustles celebrities are investing in.

t: Tosh.0 November 24, 2020 - The Masked CeWEBrity Singer
d: Daniel checks in with some musically challenged former guests to see how far they've fallen since being on the show, and reminisces about the unholy dumpster fire that was 2020.
I denne uges afsnit kommer Antoine Dobson for at få netoprejsning, og Daniel spiller Angry Birds og fortæller om, hvad han lavede i ferien.
I denne uges afsnit kommer Brian Atene forbi for at få netoprettelse og Daniel leder efter den hjemløse mand med fløjlsstemmen.
I denne uges Tosh.0 får ismanden netoprettelse og Daniel fortæller om sine følelser over for en sen aftenvært.
Pigen, der kiksede nationalsangen, får netoprettelse; Daniel leger med et stort sværd og giver sit bud på udfaldet af Super Bowl.
Daniel viser sin usendte Super Bowl-reklame og konkurrerer med Evolution of Dance Guy.
